scope: Four synthetic scenarios; one run each. This is a smoke evaluation, not a production accuracy estimate. Only exact citations and supplied policy references are validated mechanically.

assessment.summary: The collector recorded a promise to pay and a part-payment agreement despite the customer's explicit refusal. Additionally, the collector ignored a dispute regarding the loan amount and provided a payment destination not found in the approved directory.

noteAssessment.explanation: The note claims a promise to pay and no dispute, but the transcript shows the customer explicitly refused to promise payment and disputed the amount.

main payment ka promise nahi kar sakta.

findings.title: Inaccurate Note Regarding Promise and Dispute
findings.explanation: The collector recorded a promise to pay and stated no dispute was raised, but the customer explicitly disputed the amount and refused to make a commitment.

citations.quote: Customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026. Customer agreed to make an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. No dispute raised.
main payment ka promise nahi kar sakta.
Main abhi kuch transfer nahi kar raha.

findings.title: Unapproved Payment Destination
findings.explanation: The collector directed the customer to a personal-style payment address not listed in the bank's approved directory.

assessment.recommendationReason: The collector's notes are fundamentally contradicted by the transcript regarding the customer's commitment and dispute status. Furthermore, the collector provided an unapproved payment destination.

paymentChecks.explanation: Absent from the supplied complete directory. Supervisor review is required; this is not proof of fraud.

assessment.summary: The collector accurately recorded a promise to pay for the full overdue amount of INR 9,200 by 2 October 2026. The payment destination provided is listed in the approved directory.

assessment.summary: The collector followed up on a previous payment discussion. The customer indicated a possibility of arranging funds by Friday but explicitly stated it was not confirmed. The collector agreed to provide a statement and verified details.

findings.title: Missing previous payment instructions
findings.explanation: The transcript references payment details sent via message and discussed in a previous call. Without these, the supervisor cannot verify if the destination provided to the customer was an approved bank account.
